'''Kri-Larun''' was an [[City-ship/Legends|orbital city]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].

==History==
The city of Kri-Larun was destroyed over Duro during the [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|fighting there]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], from which only [[Urrdorf City]] escaped.<ref name="Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>
